newsitem.title: USA: WHX cites strike for losses.
newsitem.headline: WHX cites strike for losses.

text.p: WHX Corp on Wednesday reported a first quarter loss of $1.92 per share saying it reflects the effects of a strike by the United Steelworkers of America which began October 1.
The company said it expects material losses will continue for the duration of the strike.
No negotiations between the company and the Steelworkers are currently scheduled, WHX added.
It said eight facilities located in Ohio, Pennsylvania and West Virginia are subject to the strike and produce 80 percent of the tons shipped on an annual basis.
